text:
QUOTE: The section is rejected, and the build falls back to the whole repo with a WARNING, if it is not a mapping, has an unknown key (so `exclude:` for `excludes:` fails), or has no usable `roots:`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: It says a declared index_scope is read first and that malformed, unknown-key or rootless declarations fall back to the whole repo, and "Nothing usable declared means" the whole-repo default.
